tool.name: hictk
tool.command: ## Disable upstream telemetry (introduced in hictk v2.1.0) so that no usage data leaves the Galaxy server. export HICTK_NO_TELEMETRY=1 && hictk convert -f --output-fmt 'hic' '$incool' '$outhic'

param.name: incool
param.label: cool/mcool data to convert to hic binary

tool.help:
This tool converts cool/mcool format files into hic binary files.
# hictk
hictk is a blazing fast toolkit to work with .hic and .cool files.
This repository hosts `hictk`: a set of CLI tools to work with Cooler, as well as `libhictk`: the C++ library underlying `hictk`.
[hictk](https://github.com/paulsengroup/hictk) is capable of reading files in `.cool`, `.mcool`, `.scool` and `.hic` format (including hic v9) as well as writing `.cool` and `.mcool` files but this tool only writes `hic` at present.
